title: Predict: Strings Are Not Arrays
hints: A `Character` is what a person sees as one character — even if it's several scalars.
A flag is 1 character, 2 scalars, 8 UTF-8 bytes. `e` + combining accent equals `é`.
jsBridge: `String` isn't an array. `s.count` walks graphemes, `s.first` is a `Character?`, and slices are `Substring`s sharing storage. Coming from JS's `s[0]` and `s.length`, every one of these needs rewiring.
